errors.text_span: Das Diagramm stellt den Prozentsatz des BIP dar, der für Bahninvestitionen in Deutschland aufgeschlüsselt nach Finanzierungsquellen aufgewendet wird.
errors.evidence: The chart does not represent 'Bahninvestitionen' (railway investments); it shows gross and net fixed capital investments of territorial authorities in relation to GDP.

errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse stellt die Jahre dar, beginnend bei 1991 bzw. 1995 und endend bei 2023, mit regelmäßigen Intervallen.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis begins at 1991 for both charts, not 1995 as stated.

errors.text_span: Höchste Werte für 1995-2023 liegen um die 2,8-3,2 %.
errors.evidence: The highest values in the left chart exceed 3% in the early 1990s, not just 2.8-3.2% for 1995-2023.

errors.text_span: Die Balken in der linken Darstellung zeigen einen Anteilsverlauf über die Jahre hinweg, wobei höhe Balken einen höheren Prozentsatz des BIP darstellen.
errors.evidence: The description fails to distinguish between the left chart (gross investments) and the right chart (net investments), which have different purposes and trends.
The description does not mention that the left chart represents gross fixed capital investments and the right chart represents net fixed capital investments.
The description does not mention the significant drop in net investments into negative values in the right chart during the late 1990s and early 2000s.
The description does not mention the scale of the vertical axis (percentage intervals of 0.5%).
The description does not mention the dashed vertical line labeled 'Bahnreform' in both charts.
The description does not mention the relatively stable trend of gross investments between 2% and 3% of GDP after 2000 in the left chart.
The description does not mention the slight upward trend in net investments after 2015 in the right chart, peaking at around 0.6% of GDP.
